page_title: AUG 2-2 HOF | Augsburg v Hoffenheim 10/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Daniel Schlager has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Hoffenheim will take a corner kick.
90+6' A pass into the penalty area from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Hoffenheim.
90+5' The resulting free kick from Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
90+4' Rough tackle by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg have a free kick.
90+4' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) replaces Vladimir Coufal.
89' A substitution has been made. Tim Lemperle goes off and Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) comes on.
89' Alexis Claude-Maurice comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
89' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg) replaces Anton Kade.
88' A player from Augsburg brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Hoffenheim are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
87' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Schlager has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Hoffenheim get a free kick.
87' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
85' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) fails to score from the penalty kick. His shot goes just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
85' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
84' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle after Bernardo (Hoffenheim) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Augsburg!
84' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
82' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
81' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim win a corner kick.
80' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
79' The attendance is 28600.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) coming on for Marius Wolf.

75' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
75' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
73' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Andrej Kramaric and he is replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
69' Anton Kade (Augsburg) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
68' It is time for a substitution. Bernardo (Hoffenheim) is on for Albian Hajdari.
66' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.

66' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
65' Daniel Schlager has issued a yellow card to Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
64' Manuel Baum decides to make a substitution. Jeffrey Gouweleeuw will be replaced by Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) for Michael Gregoritsch.
63' Today's referee Daniel Schlager rightly decides to book Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) for his harsh tackle.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. Hoffenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
60' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted! Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) has too much to say to the referee and receives a yellow card.
57' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Hoffenheim are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
57' Hoffenheim quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
56' The linesman signals that Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
54' Daniel Schlager shows a yellow card to Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg).
52' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
51' A player from Hoffenheim commits a rough challenge. Daniel Schlager blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick is awarded to Augsburg.
50' Daniel Schlager has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim). Augsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Augsburg.
42' 2 - 2 It’s a GOAL! It looked impossible to score from that angle, but Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) somehow finds the net with a cheeky shot past the keeper from close in.
40' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle. Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play. Augsburg are awarded the free kick.
40' Finn Dahmen makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) after a cross from the side.
38' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' 2 - 1 Gooal! Vladimir Coufal takes over corner duties. Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it low into the middle of the net. 2:1.
35' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

35' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Augsburg.
30' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Augsburg have a free kick.
30' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

29' Anton Kade (Augsburg) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Oliver Baumann pulls off an easy save.

27' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Augsburg are awarded a free kick.
26' Chance! Anton Kade (Augsburg) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
24' The foul by Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Schlager.

24' It looks like Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Schlager won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Augsburg.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
23' A cross into the box from Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is cleared.
22' A lofted cross from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
22' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' Hoffenheim keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
18' A pass from Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
17' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
16' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniel Schlager didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

14' 2 - 0 Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) meets a perfect cross from Jeffrey Gouweleeuw on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike straight into the bottom right corner. It's 2:0.
13' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Robin Fellhauer, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

8' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

7' Close! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.

7' Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
7' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) takes the corner with a short pass.
6' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Augsburg earn a corner.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Augsburg in a dangerous position.
4' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Hoffenheim will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
3' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
2' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Augsburg will kick the game off.
Daniel Schlager was nominated as the referee for this game.
